title: Skill Dragon Punch
wikitext:
{{expand}}
A '''Human''' [[Monk]] special attack. Dragon Punch is trainable at level 25, where it replaces [[Eagle Strike]] as the Monk special punch attack. It is the last punch attack Monks get during the Classic Era.

Iksar Monks get [[Skill Tail Rake|Tail Rake]] instead.

== Classes ==

* [[Monk]] - Level 25 '''(Max 225)'''
